sources.entry: ForkLift - The most advanced dual pane file manager and file transfer client for macOS.

summary.name: ForkLift 4
summary.one_liner: ForkLift 4 is a dual-pane file manager and file transfer client for macOS that connects to FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, and many cloud and network storage services.
use_cases: transfer files to and from remote servers
manage cloud storage like S3 or Google Drive on a Mac
replace Finder with a dual-pane browser
edit remote files directly in a local editor
summary.what_it_does: ForkLift is a dual-pane file manager for macOS that connects to local drives, network volumes, and many remote and cloud services including SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, SMB, AFP, and NFS. It compares source and target folders to flag matching, modified, new, and deleted files, and can synchronize them one- or two-way. Transfers can be monitored in real time, reordered, subject to conflict and error rules, and bandwidth-limited. It also offers a preview panel, quick text editing, archive browsing, tags, git status and commands, and Multi Rename presets.
notable: Dual-pane folder comparison with one- or two-way sync
Connects to many remote and cloud protocols and services
Browse local and remote archives as folders
Git status, add, commit, push and pull inside the app
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page
